info.title: Armikom API
info.description: Unified API for Armikom alarm monitoring platform. Consolidates business logic from XAF, Blazor, AngularWeb, and mobile backends.

post.summary: Submit usage telemetry events
post.description: Accepts a batch of client-side usage telemetry events (window open/close, tab switching, navigation, action executions). This is NOT an audit trail — it records UI activity for analytics. For domain-write audit, see IAuditService (R4.8). Fire-and-forget on the client: a failed telemetry post must never block navigation or surface to a user. Events are written to the structured log (Seq) with the same property names as XAF's UserActivityLoggerController: SessionId, UserId, UserName, SourceContext.

post.summary: Relay live call transcript events to the operator's console
post.description: Internal endpoint for CopilotX. Each event names the operator's PBX extension, and the resulting `copilot-conversation` SSE frame reaches only the console whose `ext` claim matches — cross-center admins included, since a call has two parties and neither is a supervisor. Nothing is stored: CopilotX owns the transcript, the API only fans it out. Acceptance (202) means published to the connected consoles, not read by anyone. Events that cannot be routed or rendered are dropped individually and reported in `rejections`; only an empty or oversized batch fails the request. Requires the X-Service-Api-Key header — a bearer token is refused with COPILOT.SERVICE_ONLY.

AdminWriteResponse.description:
Uniform body returned by every admin create and update. Update returns the id
it was given, so a client can use one response shape for both verbs.

resolvedTimeZone.description:
Effective timezone after resolving the Side → Customer → MonitoringCenter chain.
Null when no timezone is configured anywhere in the chain (display as UTC).

kind.description:
`call-started`, `call-status`, `segment`, `suggested-action` or
            `summary`. An unknown kind rejects the event, not the batch.

callId.description: CopilotX's call id — the console threads the conversation on it.

operatorExtension.description:
The operator's PBX extension. This is the delivery address: the frame reaches the one
console whose `ext` claim matches, and no other.

signalEventId.description:
The signal event this call relates to. Set when the call was initiated via click-to-dial
from an alarm workspace. Allows the console to link the call to a specific alarm.

CopilotConversationEventDto.description:
One event. Armikom.Api.Contracts.Copilot.CopilotConversationEventDto.Kind selects which of the three optional payloads is populated;
the other two are absent.

events.description: Oldest first. The relay preserves this order inside each frame it publishes.

CopilotConversationIngestRequest.description:
A batch of live-call events posted by CopilotX. Batched rather than one request per
utterance because interim speech results arrive several times a second per channel and
the API's global rate limit is a per-principal budget, not a per-endpoint one.

rejectedCount.description: Events dropped because they could not be routed or rendered.

rejections.description: Up to ten reasons, in batch order. Null when nothing was rejected.

CopilotConversationIngestResponse.description: What the relay accepted. 202 means published, not read by an operator.

scope.description: The scope the operation needs. Advisory; the endpoint behind it still enforces its own.

parameters.description: Pre-fill values for the dialog, always strings.

CopilotProposedOperationDto.description:
The console operation being proposed. The name is not validated against a vocabulary
here — the console runs the ones it knows and renders the rest as text, so a new
operation ships without an API release and an older console cannot be told to run
something it does not understand.

isFinal.description: False while the recogniser is still revising this line.

sequenceKey.description: Shared by every interim of one utterance and by the final that closes it.

id.description: Stable across re-raises of the same finding, so the console can drop repeats.

kind.description: `info`, `prompt` or `operation`. Unknown values degrade to a text card.

CopilotSuggestedActionDto.description:
Something for the operator to know, to write, or to do. A proposal is never a command:
an Armikom.Api.Contracts.Copilot.CopilotSuggestedActionDto.Operation only tells the console which dialog to open pre-filled.

sideId.description:
Required. The subscriber to link the new mobile user to.
Without a side link the user would be invisible to all tenants (D28).

CreateMonitoringCenterRequest.description:
Create body. Secret fields are write-only — they are accepted here and never
echoed back by any read.

validForSeconds.description: How long the command stays collectable. Defaults to 5 minutes.

CreateSignalRelationRequest.description: Create body. The two membership lists are replace-all sets of SignalType ids.

DeviceRegexDetail.description:
A named parser for one device family. The Engine applies Armikom.Api.Contracts.Admin.DeviceRegexDetail.RegexText
to the raw packet, so a malformed pattern silently stops signal ingestion —
the API validates it before storing.

monitoringCenterId.description:
Optional. When the client knows the monitoring center (from entity context or
user selection), pass it to skip server-side resolution. Must belong to the
caller's tenant scope.

EmergencyPhoneDetail.description: A shared emergency contact (police, fire, ambulance) shown to operators.

LinkMobileUserRequest.description:
Body for `POST /v1/sides/{sideId}/mobile-users`.
Supply Armikom.Api.Contracts.MobileUsers.LinkMobileUserRequest.MobileUserId to link an existing user,
or Armikom.Api.Contracts.MobileUsers.LinkMobileUserRequest.Name/Armikom.Api.Contracts.MobileUsers.LinkMobileUserRequest.Phone/Armikom.Api.Contracts.MobileUsers.LinkMobileUserRequest.Password to create-and-link.
Supplying both is rejected as ambiguous.

alreadyLinked.description: True when the link already existed; the call changed nothing and returns 200.

keys.description:
Flat key→value map. Keys use dot notation with section prefixes:
<list type="bullet"><item>`UI.*` — shared UI labels (from SharedResource.resx)</item><item>`SMS.*` — SMS template strings (from SmsStrings.resx)</item><item>`ERROR.*` — error code messages (from ErrorCodes catalogue)</item><item>`ENUM.{Type}.{Value}` — enum member labels</item><item>`ACTION.*` — action/command labels (from xafml)</item></list>

LocalizationBundleResponse.description:
Full localisation bundle for a given culture.
Clients cache this response keyed by ETag; subsequent requests use If-None-Match.

monitoringCenterId.description:
Present on MC-scoped collections (account-types, account-items, signal-explanations).
Null for global/cross-MC items. Enables cross-MC admin clients to filter by entity context.

MailSettingDetail.description:
A named SMTP profile scoped to a monitoring centre. The password is never
returned — Armikom.Api.Contracts.Admin.MailSettingDetail.HasPassword reports whether one is stored.

MobileOperatorDetail.description: A GSM operator, used to classify SIM cards.

MonitoringCenterDetail.description:
A monitoring centre with its infrastructure configuration.
Secrets are never returned: each credential is reported as a
`has…` boolean so the console can show "configured / not configured"
without ever holding the value.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

instance.description: URI of the request that caused the problem

errors.description: Per-field validation errors (field name → error codes)

ProductDetail.description: A sellable product, referenced by subscriber product lines.

PromptDetail.description: An AI prompt template, attachable to alarm categories.

ProsecCommandDetail.description:
A queued panel command. Rows are consumed by the panel when it next polls,
which stamps Armikom.Api.Contracts.Admin.ProsecCommandDetail.SentAt; a row past Armikom.Api.Contracts.Admin.ProsecCommandDetail.ValidUntil is dropped.

communicationType.description: 0 = serial, 1 = network. Mirrors the legacy integer column.

sideAllowDefault.description: Default admission rule for sides not covered by an explicit receiver rule.

ipAddressAllowDefault.description: Default admission rule for source IPs not covered by an explicit receiver rule.

ReceiverDetail.description: A signal receiver — the socket or serial port the Engine reads events from.

monitoringCenterId.description:
The monitoring center this receiver belongs to.
Enables cross-MC admin clients to filter receivers by entity context.

ReceiverRuleDetail.description:
An explicit admission rule for one receiver: either a side number or a source IP,
with the decision to allow or reject it. Read by the Engine on every event.

from.description: Reserve an explicit range [from, to]. Mutually exclusive with Armikom.Api.Contracts.Sides.ReserveDealerSideNosRequest.Count.

to.description: Reserve an explicit range [from, to]. Mutually exclusive with Armikom.Api.Contracts.Sides.ReserveDealerSideNosRequest.Count.

count.description: Take the lowest N free numbers in the MC range. Mutually exclusive with From/To.

title.description: Optional title; defaults to the subscriber's monitoring center name.

recipients.description:
"first-contact" (default) | "explicit" | "contacts".
"contacts" uses Armikom.Api.Contracts.Messaging.SendSmsRequest.ContactIds to resolve phones from SideContacts.

contactIds.description: Used when Recipients = "contacts". Each id must belong to the target Side.

note.description: Optional note stored on the SMS rows. Write-only — nothing consumes this today.

recall.description: Optional recall flag stored on the SMS rows. Write-only — no call-back system exists.

resolvedTimeZone.description:
Effective timezone after resolving the fallback chain:
Side.TimeZone → Customer.TimeZone → MonitoringCenter.TimeZone → null.

eventCode.description: The code as it appears in the packet — the Engine's lookup key together with the protocol.

SignalDetail.description:
One row of the signal dictionary: the mapping the Engine looks up when a packet
arrives. It has no name or colours of its own — those come from the
Armikom.Api.Contracts.Admin.SignalDetail.SignalTypeId it points at.

SignalDictionaryItem.description:
A row in the signal dictionary: the (protocol, event code) pair the Engine
matches an incoming packet against, plus the classification it currently
resolves to (or none, if unmapped).

timeZone.description:
IANA timezone id for rendering timestamps in local time.
Falls back to UTC when null.

SmsSettingDetail.description: A named SMS gateway profile scoped to a monitoring centre.

TechnicalPersonDetail.description:
A field technician belonging to a dealer. The password is never returned —
Armikom.Api.Contracts.Admin.TechnicalPersonDetail.HasPassword reports whether one is stored.

UpdateMailSettingRequest.description: PATCH body — omitting `mailPassword` keeps the stored one; an empty string clears it.

UpdateMonitoringCenterRequest.description:
PATCH body. A property left null is not written — so omitting a password keeps
the stored one. Sending an empty string clears the stored secret.
